summary: Executed STEP 1 (backend pytest suite) and full STEP 2 (frontend E2E) against the preview URL. Backend: 30/31 pytest cases pass (96.8%). The one failure is a TEST-CODE bug (CSV duplicate row causes BOTH occurrences of T-BCA-001 to be dropped from the registry → later mismatch test expects it to be present). Frontend: every scripted user story in the request worked end-to-end: homepage branding + developer-credit + no Google login + empty elections state; admin login with forced password change; registry CSV preview+commit (3 rows); 3 student registrations show 'Under review'; admin approves all 3 verifications; create department-scoped election with position President; nominate TEST-BCA-01/02, approve; eligibility generate + lock; readiness checklist shows all green including 'Audit-chain integrity verified'; Schedule → Open; TEST-BCA-03 votes successfully (receipt displayed only after server confirmation); revisit shows 'Ballot already recorded'; Turnout tab correctly shows '1 participated · 0' and NO per-candidate totals (privacy preserved); admin Close → Reconcile → Finalize → Publish; /results public page renders with integrity hash; /app/audit 'hash-integrity-verify-btn' returns OK (events verified); auditor + operator staff creation + forced password change on first login; auditor is denied /app/admin/registry, can record findings on /app/auditor; operator sees /app/ops with DB latency, security events, API chart, Backups panel and is denied admin pages; admin issues student password-reset token, student completes /reset-password, reuse of same token is rejected (verified via security event 'invalid_reset_token' recorded); mobile viewport 390px renders homepage, registration form and ballot flow usably. No Google / social login present anywhere.

minor.issue: Test-code inconsistency: the CSV used in test_registry_import_preview_and_commit contains a duplicate T-BCA-001 row. backend/students.py:289-290 removes the FIRST occurrence as well as the duplicate (dup_regs filter), so T-BCA-001 is not imported. The later mismatch test registers T-BCA-001 expecting registry match=mismatch → verification_status='under_review', but it gets 'pending' because the registry has no T-BCA-001. Either (a) the test's CSV should not duplicate T-BCA-001, or (b) backend should keep the first occurrence and reject only the duplicate rows (more user-friendly). Also: `audit('student.registered', ..., {'registry_match': status})` in students.py:130 passes verification_status (pending/under_review) as 'registry_match' which is misleading — should pass the registry match result string ('matched'/'mismatch'/'not_found').

action_items: Decide if the one failing pytest is a test bug (fix the CSV duplicate in test_registry_import_preview_and_commit) or a product bug (keep first occurrence of duplicate registration_number instead of dropping both) — then adjust accordingly. The product app is otherwise fully functional end-to-end.
Minor cleanup: students.py audit payload key 'registry_match' should receive the actual match result, not the verification_status.

rca of the issue: test_registration_validation_duplicates_and_mismatch fails because the CSV in test_registry_import_preview_and_commit (same module) contains BOTH `T-BCA-001,Asha Test` and `T-BCA-001,Dup Row`. The preview path in students.py builds `dup_regs = {duplicates}` and then filters rows: `rows = [r for r in rows if r['registration_number'] not in dup_regs]` — this strips the FIRST valid occurrence as well. The commit therefore inserts 4 rows (T-BCA-002, T-BCA-003, T-BBA-001, T-BCA-004) and NOT T-BCA-001. The subsequent mismatch test registers T-BCA-001 with 'Wrong Name' expecting registry_match='mismatch' → status='under_review', but match_registry returns 'not_found' → status='pending'. Mitigation: either change the test CSV to not include a duplicate of T-BCA-001, or change students.py to keep the first occurrence and reject only later duplicates (recommended, more intuitive).
